messages.author: Marcus Lim
messages.text: I have the Anselm Bank renewal in Singapore on 23-24 June. It is a customer commitment, not a focus block — I cannot be in Muskoka those days.

messages.author: Beatriz Almeida
messages.text: My approved leave is the whole week of 22 June.

messages.author: Maren Achterberg
messages.text: Reminder: the 29 June week is Kestrel's boathouse rebuild, and 20 July is held for the customer success retreat — neither is ours to take. Owen's field conference in early July is protected; only Petra can move it. The KL-5508 quote on the drive is a duplicate for the wrong week — use KL-5522.
